basic_info.description: Light filled brand new TIC home at 350 San Jose Avenue.  Perfect floor plan with large living/dining room open to kitchen with bar-top peninsula.  Kitchen showcases quartz countertops, cabinet faced appliances and sophisticated two-tone cabinetry. Spa-like bathrooms with walk-in showers, designer tile finishes and under-mounted sinks/vanities.  Raident heating and private use garden make this a one-of-a-kind offering in Noe Valley!
